# Margarita Dautova — Career & Transition Coach

> ICF PCC-certified career coach based in Munich, Germany, working with international professionals in transition, online worldwide.

Margarita Dautova helps professionals navigate career pivots, transitions, and moments of change with clarity, confidence, and sustainable action. She works 1:1 with clients and delivers workshops for organisations.

## Services
- [Career Coaching](https://www.margarita-dautova.com/coaching): 1:1 coaching packages for professionals in career transition, starting from €150.
- [Book a Free Discovery Call](https://www.margarita-dautova.com/book): A free, no-pressure 30-minute call to see if coaching is the right fit.
- [Free Career Pivot Playbook](https://www.margarita-dautova.com/free): A free guide to help identify signs you're ready for a change and map out a pivot path.

## About
- [About Margarita](https://www.margarita-dautova.com/about): Background, credentials (ICF PCC), and coaching philosophy.
